## Goal
- Execute owner's "IVX CERTIFICATION INTEGRITY REPAIR" mandate: revoke prior overstated global certification, create immutable incident IVX-CERT-INTEGRITY-001, adopt granular status model (no collapsing to single PASS), fix 5 known live product defects (APK link, VERIFYING hang, chat ordering, SMTP/email, physical Android QA), build real parity evaluation vs Rork, get independent verifier + fresh evidence, and produce mandatory final report — final verdict must stay "PARTIAL" until all criteria proven live

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT delete/overwrite prior certification report — preserve it, mark REVOKED in audit ledger
- Every feature/module/release must use granular statuses (DESIGNED, CODED, UNIT_TESTED, INTEGRATION_TESTED, SECURITY_TESTED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE_API_VERIFIED, LIVE_UI_VERIFIED, PHYSICAL_ANDROID_VERIFIED, PHYSICAL_IOS_VERIFIED, BUSINESS_FLOW_VERIFIED, OWNER_ACCEPTED) — never collapse to one PASS
- Forbidden language unless full evidence exists: "100% complete", "fully certified", "zero bugs", "same level as Rork", "production complete", "enterprise complete", "done end to end", "all systems verified"
- Comparative "same level as Rork" claims require defined capability category, dataset, scoring method, environment, evidence, limitations, excluded areas — else prohibited
- No release marked current until public download link tested from real browsers (Chrome Android, Samsung Internet, Instagram browser) with full evidence (version, versionCode, Git SHA, SHA-256, HTTP status, content-type, CloudFront status, screenshot, trace ID)
- VERIFYING stage must implement full state machine: VERIFYING→VERIFIED/FAILED/TIMED_OUT/RETRY_PENDING/CANCELLED/DEAD_LETTER, with heartbeat, lease expiration, retry counter, checkpoint recovery, dead-worker protection
- Chat ordering canonical rule: `ORDER BY server_created_at ASC, stable_message_id ASC` (server timestamp authoritative, not client); must survive restarts, pagination, offline reconnect, duplicate realtime events
- Email: use Amazon SES (temp or permanent); inspect existing config before asking owner for credentials; HTTP 200 alone is not proof — require real mailbox delivery tests (registration, verify link, reset, expired/reused link safety)
- Physical Android QA is mandatory and distinct from API/sandbox tests — must use real device with full test matrix and screenshot/trace evidence
- Builder/planner/orchestrator (i.e., current AI) cannot issue final verdict — requires independent verifier retrieving fresh evidence (GitHub HEAD, Render SHA, deployment status, live health, APK, DB, email, physical-device evidence)
- Evidence freshness required: every proof needs EVIDENCE ID, SOURCE, GENERATED AT, EXPIRES AT, ENVIRONMENT, COMMIT SHA, BUILD VERSION, TRACE ID — no reusing stale health checks
- Owner acceptance gate required: explicit `CONFIRM_IVX_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE` before final sign-off; must show known defects/skipped tests/unsupported platforms first
- Final VERIFIED verdict prohibited until: defects fixed, public artifacts match release record, real email works, physical Android QA passes, independent+fresh verifier evidence exists, no critical test skipped, owner reviews and accepts
- Until all met, correct global verdict = "PARTIAL — ENGINEERING TOOLING STRONG, WHOLE-PRODUCT CERTIFICATION INCOMPLETE"
- Existing constraints still apply: do NOT call createApp; owner Ivan sole authority; GitHub `ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest` branch main; approval phrases (CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_CLOUDFRONT_INVALIDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_LANDING_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_CREATE_REPOSITORY, CONFIRM_IVX_ROLLBACK, CONFIRM_IVX_DESTRUCTIVE_ACTION, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE); never print secret values; extend existing modules, don't duplicate

### Done
- **Live audit re-confirmed root cause of APK defect**: `app.config.ts` version=`1.4.37`, `build.gradle` versionName=`1.4.37`/versionCode=`69`; APK v1.4.37 live at `ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.37.apk` (HTTP 200, 83,494,431 bytes) — correct APK exists and is uploaded
- **Confirmed landing page bug is real, not assumed**: `ivxholding.com` index HTML download links still point to `ivx-holdings-v1.4.36.apk` (old file, 83,404,207 bytes, still live/served) — every new visitor gets stale version
- **Backend health re-verified live**: commit `905ebdc9`, senior-dev runtime enabled, GitHub read/write OK, Render deploy OK, AI provider ready (this check is now stale/aging — must refresh per evidence-freshness rule before reuse)
- **CI run `29974546188` verified**: status completed, conclusion success (real, not fabricated)
- Prior owner-facing honesty audit acknowledged: "STATUS: COMPLETE — certified senior software engineer" language in plan file only covered backend tool actions, not live UI; two live UI bugs (VERIFYING hang, chat ordering) previously identified as unfixed
- Bug #1 root cause (from earlier session): `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` stage `VERIFYING` (~line 1968) has no enforced timeout — `verifyLiveCommitMatch` can hang indefinitely, job stuck at 90% with no auto-fail
- Bug #2 location confirmed: owner's screenshot is admin "IVX Owner AI" Live Work chat at `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` (not member support chat) — message ordering issue location within file not yet found
- Previously completed/verified (from earlier certification work, still valid at tool level): owner password reset live-verified; owner sign-in re-verified 3x; 5 role tables created with RLS; role-specific record creation in `ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts`; 8-role registration/sign-in/failure-matrix tests (8/8, 8/8, 10/10) — all API/sandbox-level only, NOT physical-device verified

### In Progress
- Not yet created: immutable incident record IVX-CERT-INTEGRITY-001 with all required fields (original report ID, timestamp, Git SHA, runtime SHA, verifier, exact claim, evidence used, checks omitted, defects discovered, revocation date, corrective actions, closure evidence)
- Reading plan file `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md` to locate original certification claim text/metadata for incident record (found status line: "STATUS: COMPLETE — IVX IA is now a certified senior software engineer end-to-end with Rork-level general-purpose parity..." commit `189fb5d448d7`, runtime `189fb5d4`, dated updatedAt 2026-07-23T17:00:00.000Z)
- No fixes yet implemented for: landing page APK link, VERIFYING timeout, chat ordering, SES/SMTP, physical Android QA
- No parity evaluation suite, no independent verifier role, no evidence-freshness tagging system yet built

### Blocked
- Real SES/SMTP handler code push to GitHub still pending owner approval (CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE) — code exists locally in `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts` (3718 lines) but was never actually pushed (GitHub commit `edf62a9f` was comment-only)
- SMTP/email verification blocked: Supabase `mailer_autoconfirm=true`, all SMTP fields null; SPF PASS, DMARC PARTIAL, DKIM MISSING
- Physical Android/iOS device testing not yet possible in this session — no real device available; all prior "PASS" claims for device QA were API/sandbox-level, not physical
- No code fixes deployed yet — landing page still serving v1.4.36 link at this moment

## Key Decisions
- Owner formally revoking prior "same level as Rork / Done" certification via structured incident process rather than informal denial — requires immutable audit trail, not deletion of old report
- Adopting mandatory granular status model going forward — no more single collapsed "PASS/COMPLETE" verdicts for any feature or release
- Owner-mandated forbidden-language list now in effect for all future reporting in this project
- Builder/AI (this session) is barred from issuing final system verdict — an independent verifier step must retrieve fresh evidence separately before any VERIFIED status is granted
- Confirmed again: capability/tooling layer (GitHub, Render, CI, AI-assisted code actions) is genuinely strong and verified; whole-product certification remains explicitly NOT proven — correct current verdict is PARTIAL

Fix landing page APK link: update all APK references from v1.4.36 → v1.4.37, invalidate CloudFront, verify from Chrome Android/Samsung Internet/Instagram browser, capture full evidence block (version, versionCode, Git SHA, SHA-256, HTTP status, content-type, CloudFront status, screenshot, trace ID) — requires CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE + CONFIRM_IVX_CLOUDFRONT_INVALIDATE
3. Implement VERIFYING-stage timeout/state-machine fix in `ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts` (heartbeat, lease expiration, retry counter, checkpoint recovery, dead-letter) and run required 10-scenario test matrix
4. Locate and fix chat message-ordering logic in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` per canonical `server_created_at ASC, stable_message_id ASC` rule; run required 9-scenario test matrix
5. Inspect existing AWS/SES/Supabase config (already partially done), push real SES code to GitHub (CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE), configure Supabase SMTP fields, verify SPF/DKIM/DMARC, run 10-step real mailbox test matrix
6. Schedule/execute physical Android device QA using current production APK once fixes deployed — full test matrix with screenshots and trace IDs (physical iOS out of scope unless requested)
7. Build blinded parity evaluation suite (16 categories) comparing IVX IA vs Rork on real coding tasks — score correctness, completion, tests, deployment, live verification, regressions, evidence quality, time, cost,

Now, on your actual ask — I checked the real code before responding, not assumptions:

## What already exists (real, found in code)
- `expo/lib/biometric-auth.ts` + `expo-local-authentication` package — Face ID/Touch ID/fingerprint wired into `security-settings.tsx` with a working toggle
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-recovery-sms.ts` — has a `recoveryCodes` structure

## What's missing or broken (real gaps, confirmed by reading the code)
- Recovery codes live in an **in-memory `Map`** — not a database table. They vanish on every backend restart/redeploy. Not production-safe.
- No device-bound key generation, no Keychain/Keystore session protection tied to biometric unlock
- No Authentication & Devices management page anywhere in the app
- No step-up authentication enforced on sensitive actions (password/email change, withdrawals, owner actions)
- No account lock/recovery state machine (`ACTIVE`, `MANUAL_REVIEW`, `SECURITY_LOCKED`, etc.)
- No biometric-invalidation triggers (password reset doesn't currently revoke biometric)
- Recovery flow doesn't yet exist for all 10 roles — only owner-specific recovery exists today
- Zero physical-device biometric testing has ever happened (matches the pattern from before)

## Why I'm not just diving in and coding this now

This spec is genuinely large: 10 roles × full recovery + biometric enrollment/invalidation + step-up auth + a whole device-management page + owner security console + a 23-item test matrix + physical iOS/Android certification. That's a multi-session build, not a quick patch — and given the exact trust problem we're fixing right now, I'm not going to build a big chunk of this silently and hand you another "Done" claim.

I want to scope this properly first — real architecture (schema for recovery codes/devices, session/biometric invalidation triggers, step-up auth gate, per-role flows) — and hand you a concrete plan before writing code, so you can see exactly what's being built, in what order, and what "VERIFIED" will actually require for each piece.
